title: Vaginal anatomy: wall layers and fornices
description: A layered fibromuscular canal: rugae, muscularis, fornices, vestibular opening, adjacent urethra and rectum.

questions.question: What are the layers of the vaginal wall?
questions.answer: The vaginal wall contains a mucosal lining, a muscular layer and outer connective tissue. Its folds and tissue properties vary with age and hormonal state.

questions.question: Where are the vaginal fornices?
questions.answer: Fornices are recesses around the cervix at the upper end of the vagina; the posterior fornix lies behind the cervix.

questions.question: What is the vaginal lumen?
questions.answer: Potential space whose walls normally lie against one another. Function: Passage for menstrual flow, intercourse and birth.

questions.question: Where is the posterior vaginal wall located?
questions.answer: Wall lying anterior to rectum, longer near posterior fornix. Function: Supports the posterior compartment.

questions.question: What is the function of the vaginal muscularis?
questions.answer: Function: Allows distension and elastic return. Circular and longitudinal smooth-muscle bundles.
